meta.title: Top up my credits | Izacki
meta.description: Top up your Izacki credits balance by bank card.

solde.title: Top up my credits
solde.lead: Credits pay for games and content in the Launcher. The bigger the pack, the less each credit costs.

login.title: Log in to top up your credits.
login.text: Your credits belong to your Izacki account, the same one on the site and in the Launcher.

how.title: How it works
how.paymentText: By card, on a Stripe payment page. 3-D Secure authentication may be requested.
how.returnText: You come back to this page once the payment is complete.
how.balanceText: It updates in the Launcher a few seconds after the payment.
how.useText: Credits only have value within the Izacki ecosystem: they are neither cash nor a cryptocurrency.
how.limitsText: Daily and weekly purchase limits apply.

msg.success: Payment received. Your credits have been added; your balance updates in the Launcher within a few seconds.
msg.canceled: Payment canceled. Nothing has been charged.

err.salesPaused: Credit purchases are temporarily suspended. Please come back a little later.
err.disabledUser: Your account can't buy credits right now. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.
err.tooManyOpen: You already have payments in progress. Complete them or wait for them to expire.
err.tooManyOpenRetry: You already have payments in progress. Complete them or wait for them to expire, then try again in about
err.limit: You have reached the credit purchase limit for this period. Try again later.
err.limitRetry: You have reached the credit purchase limit for this period. Try again in about
err.purchaseLimit: We couldn't start the payment. Contact us.
err.unavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
err.generic: We couldn't start the payment. Try again in a moment.
